subCustomerData.whyAsk.zh_en: Why do we need this information?
subCustomerData.whyAsk._note: "ask for" → "need". Slightly different framing; same intent.

subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.en:
We need your country of residence to manage VAT (this has no impact on the price you pay - the price you are shown is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications of failed payments, and reminders prior to renewal. Your email address also serves as a last resort for canceling your subscription in case you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing purposes, newsletters, or any other kind of unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment provider to process your payment, primarily for fraud prevention.

We will, however, never share your data with any other parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

All data is handled in compliance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection laws, regardless of your country of residence.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.zh:
我们需要您的居住国来管理增值税（这不会影响您支付的价格——您看到的价格即为最终价格）。

我们仅用您的电子邮件地址发送收据、付款失败通知以及续订前的提醒。您的电子邮件地址也是在您失去账户访问权时取消订阅的最后手段。

我们绝不会将您的电子邮件地址用于营销、通讯或任何未经请求的通信。

上述数据与我们的支付提供商共享以处理您的付款，主要用于防止欺诈。

但是，我们绝不会将您的数据与任何其他第三方共享。详情请查看我们的隐私政策。

无论您居住在哪个国家，所有数据均依据 GDPR 及瑞士数据保护法进行处理。
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.zh_en:
We need your country of residence to manage VAT (this has no impact on the price you pay - the price shown is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications of failed payments, and reminders before renewal. Your email address also serves as a last resort for canceling your subscription if you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing, newsletters, or any other unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment provider to process your payment, primarily for fraud prevention.

However, we will never share your data with any other third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

All data is handled in compliance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection laws, regardless of your country of residence.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo._note: Multiple minor differences throughout: "prior to" → "before"; "any other parties" → "any other third parties" (zh more specific); "marketing purposes" → "marketing" (simplified). All functionally equivalent.
